title: Millefeuille Approved Live Audit Record
description: Sanitized receipt-validation or receipt-consumption evidence. It never contains credentials, private payloads, or provider responses.
x-millefeuille-semantic-validation: Runtime construction must use the allowlisted receipt model and independently derived request digest; arbitrary receipt or request fields must never be copied into audit output.

Consumers must reconstruct and verify both receipt_digest and request_digest, the approval/evaluation window, selected_item_count <= scope.max_items, and secret_material_persisted=false before audit records influence replay state.
Only status=consumed records enter replay state; status=validated records prove a no-effect gate check and do not consume authorization.
